description: Still water with a refined box whose sides run through the free surface, placed for the load of the ranks (G 40 1) on 2 ranks, G 8 1, G 29 1, G 28 3: the pressure of G 29 goes from the shadow of a patch to the rank of its level-0 cells (restrict_scalars). Before, level 0 kept the plain mean under a patch on another rank: 1.3e-3 m/s after 0.5 s, with it 5e-7 m/s.
covers: cfd_amr::restrict_scalars: the pressure of G 29 from the shadows (G 40)
